metadata.title: Impact of the Galactic Disk and Large Magellanic Cloud on the Trajectories of Hypervelocity Stars Ejected from the Galactic Center

notes: The supplied paper is a theoretical population study of hypervelocity stars ejected from the Galactic Center. It does not identify any individual stars, named HVSs, or Gaia source IDs, and its “unbound” objects are simulated ensemble members rather than identifiable observed stars. Therefore, no star meets the eligibility rules for candidates_found or follow_up.
